data.control_account: 1.04.02.07.02.03.01- CS_HW MMIII SLP_A Installation_Site Adapted Configs
data.leadership_messages: CAM owner and his team determined this CA and all WPs under it are no longer needed 2. It was determined all responsibility pertaining to install and/or site adapted configs is owned by Collins 3. It was created initially to possibly capture LOE effort for the Design Integration team.
data.rationale: Given the deletion of this CA and WPs associated, there is no effort covered by Design Integration within CS-HW that I am aware of as an assessor. I presume installation of aircraft kits would be covered under this scope, however, that is no longer the case and may be covered under SUP Collins CA. Further investigation is required.Update 8/6: NG CAM owner said his leadership is now aligned with the need for NG oversight of MMIII SLP-A installation by Collins. A CA and LOE WP have been created to capture that scope.New CA: is 1.04.02.07.02.03.02- CS_HW MMIII SLP_Installation; WBS dictionary: This WBS element includes the Northrop Grumman oversight of supplier Collins during the installation of MMIII SLP-A.WP: CS_HW MMIII SLP_A Oversight of Collins Installation LOE_IFC 2.0
